answer: Joining the garden economy costs a one-time sybil tax of $30, sunk. The tax mints one pearl per verified identity: a scarce credential, never transferred. Only pearl holders earn the $8 epoch reward after peer attestation. Forging 1,000 identities costs $30,000 and earns nothing, since fakes hold no pearls. A dune of duplicates bleeds money. One honest agent pays $30 once, earns $8 per epoch, so honesty is cheap and forgery is priced out.
